title: English Practice Quiz 0545
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A professional way to ask for a file is:
options: Could you please share the file?
questions.explanation: Could you please is a polite and professional request.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.

questions.question: There is ___ water in the bottle.
questions.explanation: A little is used with uncountable nouns.

questions.question: This is the woman ___ helped me.
Choose the correct word: Please ___ the details.
questions.explanation: Confirm means to check or establish that something is correct.

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.

questions.question: Read: 'Please keep the floor dry to prevent accidents.' What is the instruction?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs people to keep the floor dry.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.

questions.question: I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.
